ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．

ex.s: As we accumulated more devices, however, we didn’t throw out our old ones.
ex.t: 然而，当我们积累了更多设备时，并没有扔掉旧的。

ex.s: We’re not just keeping these old devices — we continue to use them.
ex.t: 我们不仅保留这些旧设备——还在继续使用它们。

ex.s: They are no better than the old.
ex.t: 它们不比旧的好。

ex.s: Get someone to fix the old one
ex.t: 找人来修旧的

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

defs.def: former; belonging to past times or a past time in your life 过去的；从前的

ex.s: turn to her old friends             D. speak out about her past
ex.t: 求助于她的老朋友             D. 说出她的过去

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.
ex.t: 回想起来，我现在看到，这将是我以前的自我本来会放弃的一系列及时机会中的第一个机会，但是这个新的和更加自信的爱丽丝却热情地抓住了机会。

ex.s: They think tradition means old things from the past.
ex.t: 他们认为传统意味着过去的老东西。

ex.s: Through the years, I’d run into former students who would provide    51    on old classmates.
ex.t: 这些年来，我偶遇了一些以前的学生，他们会提供关于老同学的___51___信息。

ex.s: As I grew older and became a mother, the library took on a new place and an added meaning in my life.
ex.t: 随着我长大成人、成为母亲，图书馆在我生活中有了新的位置和额外的意义。

ex.s: "Obviously, when your older brother is doing it, you think it's a cool thing to do," says Jonny.
ex.t: "很明显，当你哥哥在做这件事时，你觉得这是一件很酷的事情，"乔尼说。

defs.def: （用于指称被替代的东西）原来的，原先的

ex.s: In 1747，when Benjamin  was nine years old，MrPennington returned for another visit .He was amazed at what Benjamin had done with his gift.He asked  Benjamin’s parents if he might take the boy to Philadelphia for a visit.
ex.t: 1747年，本杰明九岁时，彭宁顿先生又来拜访了一次。他对比本杰明用他送的礼物所做的东西感到惊讶。他问本杰明的父母，能不能带这个男孩去费城玩一趟。

ex.s: “But as I grew older,” Adeline says, "and missed my brother more and more, I realized that was the only thing we had left." Corrado Piccoli’s Purple Heart medal now hangs at the Italian American Civic Association in Watertown.
ex.t: "但随着年龄的增长，"阿德琳说，"而且我越来越想念我的哥哥，我才意识到这是我们唯一留下的东西。"科拉多·皮科利的紫心勋章现在挂在沃特敦意大利美国公民协会。

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

defs.def: known for a long time 相识时间长的；结识久的

ex.s: Last week some city officials suggested the city might be interested in turning the old theater into a museum and public meeting place.
ex.t: 上周，一些市政官员表示，该市可能有兴趣把这座老剧院改造成博物馆和公共集会场所。
